text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces errors. Productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees work faster and focus on important decisions. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often works alongside humans. This collaboration allows workers to use AI for data analysis while they provide creativity and judgement. However, jobs are changing. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, such as AI trainers and data managers. Therefore, workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive.
